en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated Baroque crucifixion altar. At the center is a large crucifix of Jesus on the cross, surrounded by putti (cherubs), clouds, rays of light, and ornate columns. Below the crucifix stands a statue of a female saint above a framed depiction of a holy face. The text at the bottom identifies the scene as an altar in a church in Graz.
